text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being Shinko Windy's trainer has<n>been hectic but
fulfilling. The mountain<n>of work on my desk keeps
growing,<n>though...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You! You've been a real drag lately!<n>It's always
work this, work that,<n>work, work, work!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well guess what—I'm your boss! And<n>your respect
for your boss is<n>severely lackin'!
choice_data_list: It's a consequence of your success.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mughh! Still... Even if that's true!<n>What's the point
if ya make it so<n>BORING?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I've had enough! I'm taking matters<n>into my own
hands! It's time for your<n>punishment!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I chase her around campus and<n>eventually spot a
familiar pair of ears<n>poking out of a bush.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon closer inspection, I notice that<n>one patch of
ground is a different<n>color—a trap. Thankful I noticed
in<n>time, I walk around it, and then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: KYAHAHA! Welcome to Windy's<n>territory of terror!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
How was that little sprinkle for a<n>warm welcome?
And now... watch<n>your step!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
One step backwards right into the pit!<n>I told you to
watch out!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you must be lonely down there, so<n>have a
friend—here!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yup... a toy one! Neeheehee! ♪ You<n>should've seen
the look on your<n>face, Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I crawl out of the pit and walk over to<n>Windy,
when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snap!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: DAAAHAHAHA! Caught a big one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My ankle gets caught in something,<n>and next thing I
know I'm pulled up<n>into the air feet first and faced
with a<n>cheeky grin.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha. ♪ So, how does it feel<n>hanging upside
down?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No can do—this is your punishment!<n>Eat my skirt!
Sucks to suck!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Catch me if you can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I chase after her, only to get caught in<n>another trap.
And another, and<n>another...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What, you pooped out already?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you won't make a very useful<n>lackey to
Windy like that!
choice_data_list: Oh yeah? Well how about now?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I whip out the toy spider from earlier<n>and swoop in
to exact revenge! But in<n>the next instant...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nice try! Shishimai says thanks for<n>the snack!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ya really thought you could get Windy<n>with such an
obvious trick?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Hopeless! I'll teach ya how a<n>pro does it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Still don't get it? Ya have to distract<n>them with
something else, then go in<n>for the kill!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Also, the more eye-catching the feint,<n>the more time
it buys to prep your<n>next trick! Think konjac jelly or
water!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Windy makes me fill a notebook with<n>prank ideas
and proceeds to grade<n>them.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm? Heh, of course I am!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
A big bad pulls off dastardly deeds<n>that no one
sees coming!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That'll be you eventually. Yer gonna<n>be a genius
prankster just like<n>Windy!
choice_data_list: I'm not sure I want to be...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This started with me trying to catch<n>Windy, but now
I'm being held<n>captive in her prank lessons.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the meantime, I can't help but<n>wonder if her
creativity could be put<n>to better use somehow...
